WORKSHOPS / THE FIVE-DAY EXECUTIVE MASTERCLASS

INDEPENDENT PRACTICE / CAPE TOWN

Strategic Design
Leadership in
the Age of AI

Five days. Five strategic decisions. One coherent direction.

Organisations rarely suffer from a shortage of plans. They struggle to make the choices that matter: where to compete, how to win, what capabilities to develop and what to stop doing.

This executive masterclass combines strategic decision design, behavioural understanding and AI-assisted exploration to turn unresolved strategic questions into actionable choices.

THE FORMAT

Five standalone working sessions form one integrated strategic progression.

For executive leaders, strategy directors and business-unit owners.
